blocks.text: Filipino-American musician April Harper Grey, known professionally as Underscores, has made history at the 69th Annual Grammy Awards. The 26-year-old singer and producer earned her first Grammy nomination on November 16. She is the first openly transgender woman nominated for Best Dance/Electronic Recording. READ: Filipino artists shine across 2027 Grammy nominations Her nomination is for the track “Music.” The song serves as the lead single from her third studio album, “U,” which was released in March 2026 under Mom + Pop Music. Grey wrote, produced, and mixed “Music” herself. She now faces major international stars in the Best Dance/Electronic Recording category. […]...
